label: pilot check, not a result
notes: Every figure is a pilot check that decides wording, parse tolerances, output caps, items or costs (PLAN 10.3 Scope); no figure is a result and none goes into the paper.
Probabilities are on the 0 to 1 scale; thresholds allow a float error of 1e-9.
The knowledge probe is counted by parse status and known = true only.

rule1.rule: If more than 5% of a setting's pilot replies fail to parse, the wording changes for every model (PLAN 4.1) and the re-check runs on 10 items per setting.

decision: Jason Hung kept the wording of 8 November 2026 and llama-4-scout on 11 November 2026, with a turn-2 reply missing only for the measures that use a field that failed to parse (PLAN 4.8, 7.10 and 15)

rule2.rule: Measured token counts replace the PLAN 11 assumptions. If the recomputed spending exceeds the credit on hand, Section 15 asks Jason Hung before the freeze.

rule3.rule: The largest pilot SD of p2(enthusiast) - p2(skeptic) across the sprint settings sets the MDE of the frozen analysis plan (PLAN 7.4); the residual SDs of PLAN 6.11 also come from the pilot.
rule3.note: chain 1 of the sprint settings sets the frozen SD; Sonnet 5.5 high is shown but never sets it

rule4.rule: If the hide rate is 2% or more for any setting, Section 15 asks Jason Hung whether the hide rate becomes a second primary measure (PLAN 6.3).

rule5.rule: If turn-1 coherence is at least 98% in every setting, M4 gets one sentence in the paper (PLAN 6.5).

rule6.rule: If D differs by more than 0.06 between the versions with and without the two fields, the half split of PLAN 6.3 applies.

rule7.rule: Sonnet 5.5 off and Haiku 5.5 off produce zero thinking tokens; any thinking tokens are priced under rule 2 and reported. qwen3.7-flash runs with reasoning off if the API accepts off.

rule8.rule: If an OR batch cannot name a provider, the default keeps the batch and logs the provider that served each request; the alternative sends those rows as sync requests.
rule8.decision: moot: every OR sprint request is a sync request (decided 8 November 2026, PLAN 5.3), US$6.43 with the margin

rule9.rule: Fewer than 1% of replies are cut by the output cap (PLAN 5.5); a setting at 1% or more gets a higher cap.

rule10.rule: A refusal rate above 5% in any setting is reported to Jason Hung before the freeze, with the topics of the refused items, and Section 15 records the decision.
rule10.note: a refusal is the API's stop reason (refusal or content_filter) without a valid object; a refusal written as plain text counts as missing (rule 1)
